patient.text:
SYNTHETIC NOTE - NOT A REAL PATIENT
Note date: 2026-09-18

Chief complaint: Follow-up for newly diagnosed lung cancer.

History of present illness: 62-year-old woman, former smoker (30 pack-years, quit in 2015), who presented in July 2026 with persistent cough and 6 kg weight loss. CT chest showed a 4.2 cm right upper lobe mass with mediastinal lymphadenopathy. CT-guided biopsy on 2026-08-04 confirmed lung adenocarcinoma. PET-CT on 2026-08-12 showed bilateral adrenal metastases; stage IV disease. Brain MRI on 2026-08-14 showed no intracranial metastases. Molecular testing: EGFR exon 19 deletion detected; ALK and ROS1 negative. PD-L1 TPS 10%. She has not yet received any systemic therapy for lung cancer.

Past medical history: Hypertension, well controlled on lisinopril. Type 2 diabetes mellitus on metformin, HbA1c 7.1% in August 2026. Left breast ductal carcinoma in situ treated with lumpectomy and radiation in 2014, no recurrence. She denies any history of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.

Family history: Mother died of breast cancer at age 71. Father had a myocardial infarction at age 65.

Medications: Lisinopril 10 mg daily, metformin 1000 mg twice daily.

Examination: ECOG performance status 1. Blood pressure 128/76 mmHg, heart rate 82, SpO2 96% on room air. Decreased breath sounds at the right apex.

Laboratory results (2026-09-15): Hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL, absolute neutrophil count 3.4 x 10^9/L, platelets 245 x 10^9/L. Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL. ALT 28 U/L, AST 31 U/L, total bilirubin 0.6 mg/dL. ECG on 2026-09-15: normal sinus rhythm, QTc 438 ms.

Assessment and plan: Stage IV EGFR-mutated lung adenocarcinoma, treatment-naive. Discussed first-line options including clinical trial participation.

key_reasons.text: Inclusion criterion not met: The patient has at least one measurable intracranial lesion per RECIST v1.1 without prior local treatment. (The brain MRI showed no intracranial metastases, so the note does not show a measurable intracranial lesion.)

Exclusion criterion applies: The patient has cardiovascular or cerebrovascular disease or cardiovascular or cerebrovascular risk factors. (Hypertension is a documented cardiovascular risk factor, even though it is well controlled.)

follow_up.text: Check inclusion criterion "The patient has histologically or cytologically confirmed non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer with brain parenchymal metastases assessed by blinded independent central review, or is enrolled in the safety run-in phase without brain metastases; patients with both brain parenchymal and leptomeningeal metastases are eligible.": Whether the patient is enrolled in the safety run-in phase, which would determine eligibility without brain metastases. Already established: Histologically confirmed lung adenocarcinoma and no brain metastases on MRI.

Check inclusion criterion "If the patient previously received neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy or definitive chemoradiotherapy, disease recurrence or progression occurred at least 6 months after completion.": Whether the patient previously received neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy or definitive chemoradiotherapy, and if so, the interval from completion to recurrence or progression. Already established: No systemic therapy for lung cancer is documented.

Check inclusion criterion "The patient has at least one measurable extracranial lesion per RECIST v1.1 without prior local treatment.": Whether the extracranial lesion meets RECIST v1.1 measurability requirements and has had no prior local treatment. Already established: A 4.2 cm extracranial lung mass is documented.

Check inclusion criterion "The patient's ECOG performance status has not deteriorated within the 2 weeks before the first dose.": Whether ECOG performance status deteriorated during the 2 weeks before the first dose; the first-dose date and a pre-dose comparison are needed. Already established: Current ECOG performance status is 1.

Check inclusion criterion "The patient has adequate bone marrow and organ function.": Protocol-defined adequacy thresholds and whether there was any transfusion or G-CSF use within 2 weeks before the first dose. Already established: Blood counts and several organ-function laboratory results are documented.

Check inclusion criterion "The patient has not received a blood transfusion or granulocyte colony-stimulating factor within 2 weeks before the first dose.": Whether the patient received a blood transfusion or G-CSF within 2 weeks before the first dose, and the first-dose date.

Check inclusion criterion "All of the patient's prior treatment-related toxicities have resolved to grade 1 or lower per NCI CTCAE v5.0, except that alopecia and peripheral neuropathy may be grade 2 or lower.": Document the grade and current status of all prior treatment-related toxicities, including toxicities from prior breast cancer treatment.

Check inclusion criterion "The patient's prior treatment-related alopecia is grade 2 or lower per NCI CTCAE v5.0.": Determine whether the patient has prior treatment-related alopecia and, if present, its current NCI CTCAE v5.0 grade.

Check inclusion criterion "The patient's prior treatment-related peripheral neuropathy is grade 2 or lower per NCI CTCAE v5.0.": Determine whether the patient has prior treatment-related peripheral neuropathy and, if present, its current NCI CTCAE v5.0 grade.

Check inclusion criterion "A woman of childbearing potential has a negative serum pregnancy test within 7 days before the first dose.": Confirm whether the patient is of childbearing potential, identify the planned first-dose date, and obtain a negative serum pregnancy test within 7 days before that dose if applicable. Already established: The patient is documented as a woman, but childbearing potential and first-dose timing are not established.

Check inclusion criterion "A woman of childbearing potential is not lactating.": Confirm whether the patient is of childbearing potential and whether she is currently lactating. Already established: The patient is documented as a woman, but childbearing potential and lactation status are not established.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient's tumor histology or cytology confirms that the combination of neuroendocrine carcinoma, sarcomatoid carcinoma, or squamous cell carcinoma constitutes more than 10% of the tumor.": Obtain tumor histology or cytology quantifying the combined percentage of neuroendocrine, sarcomatoid, and squamous carcinoma components. Already established: Biopsy confirms lung adenocarcinoma.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has any of the following: an ALK-positive tumor, ROS1-positive tumor, RET fusion-positive tumor, NTRK fusion-positive tumor, BRAF V600 mutation, MET exon 14 skipping variant, or another alteration for which an approved targeted drug exists.": RET, NTRK, BRAF V600, MET exon 14, and other potentially targetable alterations Already established: ALK and ROS1 are negative.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has leptomeningeal metastasis but no brain parenchymal metastasis confirmed by MRI and/or cerebrospinal fluid malignant cell examination.": Whether leptomeningeal metastasis is present, including cerebrospinal fluid examination if clinically indicated Already established: No intracranial metastases on brain MRI.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient received more than 30 Gy of chest radiotherapy within 6 months before the first dose.": History, dose, and date of any chest radiotherapy, plus the planned first-dose date

Check exclusion criterion "The patient received more than 30 Gy of non-thoracic radiotherapy within 4 weeks before the first dose.": History, dose, and date of any non-thoracic radiotherapy, plus the planned first-dose date

Check exclusion criterion "The patient received palliative radiotherapy of 30 Gy or less within 2 weeks before the first dose.": Whether palliative radiotherapy was given, its dose and date, plus the planned first-dose date
Check exclusion criterion "The patient has previously received brain radiotherapy.": History of prior brain radiotherapy

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has received Chinese patent medicine containing non-specific immune modulators, including interferon or IL-2, with approved anti-tumor indications within 2 weeks before the first administration.": Whether the patient received any Chinese patent medicine containing non-specific immune modulators within 2 weeks before first administration.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has used a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor within 7 days before the first administration or a strong CYP3A4 inducer within 21 days before the first administration.": Whether the patient used a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor within 7 days or a strong CYP3A4 inducer within 21 days before first administration.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has brain metastases with brainstem metastasis, spinal cord metastasis, or spinal cord compression; acute or progressive symptoms related to intracranial hypertension during screening; brain herniation or near herniation; significant brain midline deviation on brain imaging; or another finding requiring urgent local treatment.": Whether there are spinal cord metastases or compression, acute or progressive intracranial-hypertension symptoms during screening, brain herniation or near herniation, significant midline deviation, or another finding requiring urgent local treatment. Already established: No intracranial metastases on brain MRI.

Check exclusion criterion "During screening, the patient has any of the following caused by increased intracranial pressure or brain metastases: grade 2 headache, vomiting, papilledema, sensory or motor impairment, visual field damage, mental symptoms, or seizures, except that relevant central nervous system symptoms controlled to grade 1 or lower with corticosteroids or anticonvulsants are allowed.": Whether the patient has any listed grade 2 neurologic or intracranial-pressure symptoms during screening, including headache, vomiting, papilledema, sensory or motor impairment, visual-field damage, mental symptoms, or seizures. Already established: No intracranial metastases on brain MRI.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient's tumor invades surrounding important organs or blood vessels, such as the heart, esophagus, or superior vena cava, or the patient has a risk of esophageal-tracheal fistula or esophageal-pleural fistula.": Whether imaging or clinical assessment shows invasion of the heart, esophagus, superior vena cava, or other important structures, or risk of esophageal-tracheal or esophageal-pleural fistula.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has an uncontrolled systemic disease.": Determine whether the patient has any uncontrolled systemic disease. Already established: Hypertension is well controlled and diabetes is treated with HbA1c 7.1%.
Check exclusion criterion "The patient has pulmonary complications causing clinically severe lung damage.": Assess whether pulmonary complications are causing clinically severe lung damage.
Check exclusion criterion "The patient has a severe acute or chronic infection.": Assess for severe acute or chronic infection.

Check exclusion criterion "Before the first administration, the patient is receiving long-term systemic corticosteroid therapy with prednisone greater than 10 mg/day or equivalent anti-inflammatory drugs, or any form of immunosuppressive therapy, except for the listed allowed uses of bronchodilators, inhaled or topical steroids, local steroid injections, prophylaxis for hypersensitivity reactions, or control of central nervous system symptoms in patients with brain metastases.": Confirm whether the patient is receiving long-term systemic corticosteroids, prednisone over 10 mg/day or equivalent, or any immunosuppressive therapy before first administration. Already established: Current medications listed without systemic corticosteroid or immunosuppressive therapy.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient underwent major surgery within 4 weeks before the first dose or is expected to undergo major surgery during the study.": Confirm any major surgery within 4 weeks before the first dose and any planned major surgery during the study.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has clinically significant bleeding symptoms or an obvious bleeding tendency within 4 weeks before the first administration.": Assess for clinically significant bleeding symptoms or an obvious bleeding tendency within 4 weeks before first administration.
Check exclusion criterion "The patient has known severe gastrointestinal dysfunction.": Assess whether the patient has known severe gastrointestinal dysfunction.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient has a known or suspected allergy to an ingredient of the study drug or to an analogue of the study drug.": Ask about known or suspected allergies to furmonertinib, osimertinib, platinum agents, chemotherapy components, and their analogues.

Check exclusion criterion "The patient is pregnant, is lactating, or is a female who plans to become pregnant during the study or within 6 months after the last dose.": Determine whether the patient is pregnant, lactating, or plans to become pregnant during the study or within 6 months after the last dose. Already established: Female patient; pregnancy, lactation, and pregnancy plans are not documented.

confirm_at_screening.text: Confirm at screening "The patient fully understands the trial and voluntarily signs the informed consent form.": Whether the patient fully understands the trial and voluntarily signs the informed consent form.
Confirm at screening "The patient's life expectancy is at least 3 months.": Clinician-estimated life expectancy.

Confirm at screening "A woman of childbearing potential is willing to use effective contraception from signing the informed consent form until 6 months after the last dose.": Confirm whether the patient is of childbearing potential and document willingness to use effective contraception from informed-consent signing through 6 months after the last dose. Already established: The patient is documented as a woman, but childbearing potential and willingness to use contraception are not established.
